objects.summary: P2 PR46 review finds posting-principal verification occurs after actionable dispatch/review comment is already published; wrong token actor can trigger external work and then raise locally. Identity must be established before posting control comments.

P2 PR46 review finds lower-trust model continuation prompt is embedded inside trusted orchestrator comment and marker parser scans entire body; prompt can inject a future control marker and suppress the real later dispatch. Trusted markers need a canonical isolated envelope.

P2 PR46 review finds durable state binds only task_id, not repository/issue/target branch. Reconfiguring same state namespace to another GitHub subject can return old DONE without inspecting new subject. Persist immutable subject identity and require reconciliation on change.

P2 PR46 review finds target branch can advance from qualified candidate B to C while waiting for review, yet PASS for B can still produce DONE. Target head must be revalidated immediately before QUALIFIED_RESULT/decision and stale changes reconciled.

cross_object_findings.finding: Verifying the posting principal after publishing is not fail closed; authentication must precede any control-plane side effect.
Author authentication alone cannot make embedded lower-trust prompt text into trusted control data. Parse control markers only from a canonical envelope outside delegated content.
Restart-safe state is unsafe if the same task namespace can be pointed at another repository/issue/branch and inherit terminal state. Subject identity is part of durable state semantics.
CI/review evidence for candidate B cannot terminate a task after branch advanced to C. Exact-head identity must be checked again immediately before qualification or terminal decision.
